Refine its aa symbol on the right by K to obtain F={b,ba,aab,aaba,aaaa}; composition of the abstract complete prefix refinement with K proves F UD. Its binary Kraft is1, hence it is factor-complete. Put w=aab.
finding_2_generic_stabilization_shortcut.complete_family: For r>=2 define F_r={w^j c:0<=j<r,c in F minus {w}} union {w^r}. Over the abstract alphabet F this is the complete prefix code that either exits the w-spine at its first non-w symbol or stops after r copies. Since F is UD, substitution preserves UD. With p=2^(-|w|)=1/8, its Kraft is sum_(0<=j<r) p^j(1-p)+p^r=1, so each finite F_r is factor-complete by the named elementary UD/Kraft argument.
